articles.title: Neurable Open for Business: Scaling Neurotechnology Adoption Through Global OEM Integration
articles.mainIdea: Neurable Open for Business: Scaling Neurotechnology Adoption Through Global OEM Integration
articles.summary: Business Wire: Neurable Open for Business: Scaling Neurotechnology Adoption Through Global OEM Integration. BOSTON, April 28, 2026--Neurable, the leader in AI for noninvasive brain-computer interface (BCI) technology, today announced its official transition to a licensing platform model, allowing global OEM partners to integrate its production-ready BCI technology directly into consumer wearables. This marks a major milestone for both Neurable and the BCI industry, as the company continues to spearhead necessary steps in bringing cognitive-enabled products for everyday use to consumers at scale.
